speech.heard: The global median savings rate is 22.4 percent. Qatar sets aside 57.4 percent of its GDP. Qatar has 3.5 times the USA, which stands at 16.6 percent. China hits 42.7 percent, while Brazil sits down at 14.4 percent. East Timor drops to the bottom at down 21.1 percent. Gross savings are calculated as gross national income less total consumption plus net transfers. What share of income does your country save?
